customRoutines.title: Day 1 — Upper Body Strength Builder
customRoutines.content:
### Day 1 — Upper Body Strength Builder
**Goal:** Muscle Gain · **Level:** Intermediate · **Duration:** 45 min · **Equipment:** Dumbbells & Bench

**Warm-up (5 min)**
- Arm swings & shoulder circles — 60s
- Band pull-aparts — 15 reps
- Push-ups — 10 reps

**Main sets**
| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Rest |
|---|---|---|---|
| Flat Dumbbell Press | 4 | 8–10 reps | 90s |
| Overhead Shoulder Press | 3 | 10 reps | 75s |
| Incline Dumbbell Flyes | 3 | 12 reps | 60s |
| Tricep Dips on Bench | 3 | 12–15 reps | 60s |
| Plank Shoulder Taps | 3 | 30s | 45s |

**Cool-down (3 min)**
- Chest doorway stretch — 45s
- Overhead triceps stretch — 30s each side

**Coach notes:**
Maintain controlled tension on negative movement. Rest 90 seconds between heavy presses.
